problem_statement: Ethernet drivers need a unified way to obtain a MAC address from device-tree configuration. A driver should be able to load a MAC address that is either a full static address from local-mac-address, a randomly generated address (optionally prefixed by a static OUI via zephyr,mac-address-prefix), a value read from an NVMEM cell referenced by nvmem-cell-names = "mac-address", or to report that no MAC address is available (the default case). The random variant must set the locally-administered unicast bit and clear the group bit on the first octet, while the NVMEM variant must read from the cell without setting that bit. A device tree node with no MAC address configuration must yield a load result of -ENODATA.

verification.reason: The statement describes the behaviour well but omits the exact API names, struct/field names, function signature, and the test-driver structure names that the hidden tests rely on. All of these are public interface or test-interface details that can be added without dictating the implementation.

problems.detail: The statement does not give the exact names the tests use: the enum values (NET_ETH_MAC_DEFAULT, NET_ETH_MAC_RANDOM, NET_ETH_MAC_NVMEM, NET_ETH_MAC_STATIC), the struct name (net_eth_mac_config), the function name (net_eth_mac_load), the struct fields (type, addr, addr_len, cell), the test-specific structs (vnd_ethernet_config, vnd_ethernet_data), the header (eth_test_priv.h), and the field names (mcfg, mac_addr_load_result, mac_addr).

The statement does not specify that the test driver's init must call net_eth_mac_load() and store the return value in mac_addr_load_result and the loaded MAC in mac_addr, nor that zephyr,random-mac-address takes precedence over local-mac-address on the same node (the test has a node with both properties and expects NET_ETH_MAC_RANDOM).

The tests access cfg->mcfg.cell.dev/offset/size (struct nvmem_cell fields) and cfg->mcfg.addr/addr_len; the statement must specify that net_eth_mac_config has a cell field of type struct nvmem_cell and that addr/addr_len hold the prefix.

leak_check.leak_detail: The phrase 'The vnd,ethernet test driver must be updated to use this API' identifies a source file to edit, and 'net_eth_mac_load must be called during device initialization' hints at the internal order of the fix. The rest mostly specifies the interface and required behaviour, so this is a minor leak that can be removed/reworded.
leak_check.suggested_statement:
Ethernet drivers need a unified way to obtain a MAC address from device-tree configuration. A driver should be able to load a MAC address that is either a full static address from local-mac-address, a randomly generated address (optionally prefixed by a static OUI via zephyr,mac-address-prefix), a value read from an NVMEM cell referenced by nvmem-cell-names = "mac-address", or to report that no MAC address is available (the default case). The random variant must set the locally-administered unicast bit and clear the group bit on the first octet, while the NVMEM variant must read from the cell without setting that bit. A device tree node with no MAC address configuration must yield a load result of -ENODATA.

The public API must consist of:

- An enumeration net_eth_mac_type with values NET_ETH_MAC_DEFAULT, NET_ETH_MAC_RANDOM, NET_ETH_MAC_NVMEM, and NET_ETH_MAC_STATIC.
- A structure net_eth_mac_config with fields: type (of type enum net_eth_mac_type), addr (of type uint8_t[NET_ETH_ADDR_LEN]), addr_len (of type uint8_t), and cell (of type struct nvmem_cell, present only when CONFIG_NVMEM is defined).
- A function int net_eth_mac_load(const struct net_eth_mac_config *cfg, uint8_t *mac_addr) that loads the MAC address into mac_addr based on the configuration type.
- Initialization macros NET_ETH_MAC_DT_CONFIG_INIT(node_id) and NET_ETH_MAC_DT_INST_CONFIG_INIT(inst) that produce a struct net_eth_mac_config initializer from a device-tree node or instance, respectively, mapping local-mac-address to the static case, zephyr,random-mac-address (with zephyr,mac-address-prefix as the prefix) to the random case, nvmem-cell-names = "mac-address" (with zephyr,mac-address-prefix as the prefix) to the NVMEM case, and the absence of all these to the default case.

A header eth_test_priv.h must be created in drivers/ethernet containing:

- struct vnd_ethernet_config with a field mcfg of type struct net_eth_mac_config.
- struct vnd_ethernet_data with fields mac_addr (of type uint8_t[NET_ETH_ADDR_LEN]) and mac_addr_load_result (of type int).

The vnd,ethernet device must use these structures for its config and data, and must use net_eth_mac_load to populate mac_addr and mac_addr_load_result.
